title: Counterfactual Rollouts for Offline Contrastive Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14953v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) learns goal-conditioned values by associating state--action pairs with the states subsequently reached, assuming that no unobserved variable jointly affects the recorded action and its outcome. When offline demonstrations come from a demonstrator with information hidden from the learner, this assumption fails and the critic absorbs spurious action--outcome associations. We formalize this setting with confounded Markov decision processes and introduce counterfactual transitions that separate what the data identify from what they do not; minimizing over all compatible transitions yields a worst-case occupancy that lower-bounds the true one. Causal Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CauCRL) learns a pessimistic counterfactual transition from positive and negative offline demonstrations and trains the critic on counterfactual rollouts, substantially improving success rates over standard CRL on conf

translated_title: 用于离线对比目标条件强化学习的反事实推演
translated_abstract: 对比强化学习通过将状态-动作对与随后到达的状态相关联来学习目标条件价值函数，其前提假设是不存在未观测变量同时影响记录的动作及其结果。当离线演示来自掌握学习者所不知信息的演示者时，这一假设不再成立，评论家会吸收虚假的动作-结果关联。我们用混淆马尔可夫决策过程对这一设定进行形式化，并引入反事实转移，将数据所能识别的内容与不能识别的内容分离开来；对所有兼容的转移取最小化，可得到真实占用测度的下界，即最坏情况占用测度。因果对比强化学习从正、负离线演示中学习一个悲观的反事实转移，并在反事实推演上训练评论家，在混淆环境下相比标准对比强化学习显著提升了成功率。
tldr: 提出因果对比强化学习方法CauCRL，通过从离线演示中学习悲观的反事实转移并在反事实推演上训练评论家，解决了演示者隐藏信息造成的虚假动作-结果关联问题，显著提升了目标条件强化学习在混淆环境中的成功率。
en_tdlr: Proposes CauCRL, which learns a pessimistic counterfactual transition from offline demonstrations and trains the critic on counterfactual rollouts, resolving spurious action-outcome associations caused by hidden confounders and substantially improving success rates of goal-conditioned reinforcement learning over standard CRL in confounded environments.
